Trade Service Team Member (Drive-Through)

Here at Buildmart MEGA Taupo, we’re always on the lookout for great people. We take pride in understanding our customers projects and helping them with the products and knowledge needed plus providing the best solutions and advice to get the job done.

The role will be dealing with both Trade and DIY customers in our fast-paced Drive-Through department. The key responsibilities are assisting customers within the yard and drive-through, picking and loading customers’ orders for deliveries and collection.

We are looking for a reliable, hardworking individual who is able to roll up their sleeves and assist our Trade Team, both in the yard and drive through.  This role is a permanent full-time role, including weekends on a roster basis, reporting to the Trade Operation Manager.

For this position we are seeking someone who has:

Enthusiasm and team spirited with a "can do" attitude.
Preferably a reasonable understanding of the building industry and its products.
Have solid health and safety value.
Preferably be physically fit as some manual heavy lifting is involved.
A quick and alert mind, with the ability to adapt, be flexible and willing to learn.
Excellent communication skills.
Must have a current full NZ driver's licence.
Experience using a forklift, F endorsement would be preferrable.
Valid NZ work visa, residency or citizenship.
We want to keep growing our amazing team with more exceptional talent. For us, this means hiring team players with a positive attitude and an excellent work ethic. Previous experience would be an advantage, but it's your strong personal values that align with ours that will make you successful at Buildmart MEGA Taupo.

 

If you believe you have the skills that we are seeking and wish to make a contribution to a growing business, then please apply online via this website with your CV and cover letter.

Applications for this role close 11 October 2026, however we will be reviewing and processing applications as they are received.
